mechanics.claim: Brand's abilities apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, and each new application refreshes the duration of all existing stacks.
mechanics.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application

mechanics.claim: Abilities used against a target already afflicted with Ablaze are empowered (e.g. W's empowered damage).
mechanics.quote: Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered.

mechanics.claim: Each stack of Ablaze deals its own individual damage ticks based on when it was applied, even if all stacks' durations are refreshed together.
mechanics.quote: Each stack of ''Ablaze'' deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed.

mechanics.claim: Ablaze's damage cap against a monster is applied after the monster damage multiplier is applied.
mechanics.quote: ''Ablaze's'' damage cap against a {{tip|monster}} is applied after the increased monster damage.

mechanics.claim: Reaching 3 stacks on an enemy champion or large monster triggers a ring that detonates after a 2 second delay, applying a stack of Ablaze and dealing AoE magic damage to nearby enemies; the target cannot be reapplied Ablaze for 4 seconds after a ring explodes from them.
mechanics.quote: causing it to form a fiery ring around the target that grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of ''Ablaze''

mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy afflicted with Ablaze, or any enemy with an ability, restores mana.
mechanics.quote: Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or any enemy with an ability restores {{as|{{pp|20 to 40 for 5|1;6 to 15|...}} {{sti|mana}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The Ablaze burn is persistent/indirect damage and the ring explosion is area/indirect damage.
mechanics.quote: The burn deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, and the explosion deals {{tip|area damage}}; both are additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Ablaze is a debuff that persists through the target's death.
